title: Milan Expo 2015 Legacy Site
summary: Italy's Expo 2015 attracted 21 million visitors to a purpose-built symbolic site in Milan, but post-event conversion plans collapsed repeatedly through the 2010s and into the 2020s. The 110-hectare site sat largely fallow for years, with successive development proposals — including a tech hub and an Olympic village bid — stalling over funding and governance disputes between the city, region, and national government.
